plain.li: [fealtymoot] Things have changed since you wrote, and there is no oath for us to take from you now.
[fealtymoot,theirLowtech] Matters changed before your words reached our head. There is nothing to swear to now.
[fealtymoot,theirHightech] Given how things stand now, your request no longer applies. We consider it closed.
[fealtymoot,letter] Your letter came after its moment had passed. Write again if there is cause.
[fealtymoot,call] That isn't something we can settle now, {WRITER}. Things have moved on since you asked.
[help,cordial,fealty:oath] You hold of us, so we help where we can. Do not make a habit of asking.
[greetings,cool,fealty:oath,fealty:levies:refused] We called on your oath this season and your levies never came. Our head has not forgotten it.
[greetings,curt,fealty:oath,fealty:levies:refused,theirLowtech] Your spears stayed home when we called them. Write to us when they are ready to keep your oath.
[news,cool,fealty:oath,fealty:levies:refused,theirHightech] Here is our news. You would know more of it firsthand if your people had come when we called.
